seal.statement: On FULL raft-rs persistence, the seed currently starts elections for all 45 system-table partitions before the four partitions whose leaders SeedRegistrationPhase requires for direct writes have formed. The resulting synchronous persistence load can consume the registration leadership gate before its target path is reached. SeedRegistrationPhase remains the sole owner of that exact four-partition dependency cut and its existing wait budget; SeedPartitionsPhase starts that cohort first, transfers the satisfied gate to registration, and then releases every remaining election exactly once. An active dependency failure still releases the remaining cohort before propagating, while shutdown leaves unstarted replicas to the existing cleanup owner. FULL durability and all timing constants stay unchanged.

text: Moved SeedRegistrationPhase's exact four-partition direct-write leadership gate into deferred election scheduling without changing its timeout: start only the owned dependency cohort, memoize the satisfied gate for phaseRegistration, release every remaining election in finally while bootstrap is active, and leave the unstarted cohort to cleanup during shutdown. Added deterministic ordering/failure/shutdown/single-budget witnesses, coupled-pair registry, and regenerated test metadata.
